results.name: partial_match_backend

results.name: strong_match_backend
results.summary: Priya Shah is an exceptionally strong match for the Backend Engineer role, exceeding the minimum years of experience and demonstrating direct hands-on proficiency with almost all core requirements including Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, and Docker. The only minor gaps are the specific nice-to-have message queue technologies like Kafka or SQS, which can be addressed by emphasizing existing asynchronous cloud processing experience.
